title: Senior Manager, Technical Product Management - Payment Domain
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Lead Technical Product Manager is responsible for guiding product strategy, leading technical execution, and developing a team of Technical Product Managers responsible for delivering AI-powered, consumer-facing healthcare experiences. This leader operates at the intersection of product management, technology, data, AI, and business strategy, owning outcomes from concept through adoption and business value realization.

This role partners across Product, Engineering, Architecture, AI Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, and Business stakeholders to build and scale digital experiences across web, mobile, and conversational channels. Areas of focus include Claims Assistant, Payment Experiences, intelligent document processing, reimbursement workflows, AI-powered self-service capabilities, and emerging member engagement experiences.

In addition to product ownership responsibilities, this role provides leadership, coaching, and development for Technical Product Managers, helping mature product management practices, technical capabilities, and AI-first ways of working across the organization.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Drive Product Strategy and Portfolio Direction
  + Partner with Product Directors, business leaders, and technology stakeholders to define strategy, investments, roadmaps, and priorities across Claims Assistant, Payments, and AI-powered member experiences. Identify opportunities to expand capabilities, improve member outcomes, and drive measurable business value.
* Scale Claims and Payment Experiences
  + Lead discovery, requirements, and execution efforts to expand Claims Assistant and payment capabilities into new member workflows, including claims submission, reimbursement experiences, digital payments, document intake, intelligent routing, and self-service experiences across web and mobile channels
* Lead Technical Product Delivery
  + Own product requirements, technical designs, API integrations, platform enhancements, AI capabilities, OCR workflows, and data dependencies required to deliver scalable and compliant consumer experiences. Translate business objectives into measurable technical outcomes and executable delivery plans
* Own Product Outcomes and Performance
  + Establish KPIs, success metrics, operational controls, and monitoring strategies to measure adoption, member satisfaction, completion rates, accuracy, automation effectiveness, payment success, and business impact. Drive continuous optimization based on product and operational performance
* Build and Develop TPM Talent
  + Lead, coach, and mentor Technical Product Managers responsible for product delivery across the portfolio. Establish performance expectations, develop technical product management capabilities, guide career growth, and help drive adoption of AI-enabled product management practices across the organization
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Product Management or Technical Product Management experience
* 3+ years leading enterprise-scale digital products serving external customers
* Experience owning product vision, strategy, roadmaps, objectives, KPIs, and business outcomes
* Experience delivering products in partnership with software engineering teams using Agile delivery models
* Experience leading large cross-functional initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders
* Experience working within highly regulated environments requiring security, compliance, and risk management considerations
* Demonstrated solid ability to translate business needs into detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Product & Technical Leadership
  + 5+ years working closely with software engineering teams in Agile environments
  + Experience working with cloud-native applications and modern digital platforms
  + Experience supporting complex web, mobile, and omnichannel product ecosystems
  + Experience influencing technical strategy across multiple product teams
  + Solid understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and integration patterns
  + Demonstrated ability to read architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, technical designs, system flows, and integration documentation
* AI & Intelligent Automation
  + 3+ years delivering AI, ML, OCR, GenAI, intelligent document processing, or automation solutions
  + Experience defining AI product requirements, evaluation criteria, guardrails, success metrics, and operational controls
  + Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, model evaluation methodologies, AI governance, and operational monitoring
  + Understanding of responsible AI, compliance, privacy, and risk considerations for customer-facing AI experiences
  + Familiarity with AI performance metrics including accuracy, precision, latency, confidence scoring, hallucination rates, and drift detection
* Claims & Payments
  + Experience with healthcare claims, reimbursement, payment operations, payment platforms, or financial transaction processing
  + Experience building digital self-service experiences for consumers or members
  + Experience identifying and scaling platform capabilities across multiple business use cases
  + Knowledge of payment workflows, digital reimbursement models, payment flexibility solutions, funds disbursement, and transaction lifecycle management
* People Leadership
  + Experience leading, coaching, or developing Product Managers or Technical Product Managers
  + Experience establishing operating models, product management best practices, and delivery frameworks
  + Demonstrated ability to build high-performing product teams
  + Demonstrated solid ability to influence senior leadership and align diverse stakeholder groups around shared outcomes

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Premier Service Manager- Jalandhar
description:
**Location: Jalandhar**

**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Introduction**

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

**Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

  

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.

**Additional Notes :**

Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, design, and delivery of products within the Private Funds domain of the Clearwater system. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from defining the product and planning development through production and go-to-market. You will build the product roadmap needed to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets for your component.

This is a technical product role. You will work with engineering on data models, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, and you will be a domain authority on how private funds are structured, reported, and valued. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new capabilities, partner with development teams to build and launch them, and pilot new features with clients before promoting them to the wider client base.

**Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership:** Lead and guide a team of 8-15 developers, supporting knowledge-sharing and training to build team effectiveness.
* **Product Ownership:** Own the Private Funds product(s) end to end, from ideation through market launch and ongoing evolution.
* **Backlog Management:** Prioritize and manage the backlog, balancing client-facing features, data quality, and platform investments in line with business goals.
* **Technical Requirement Definition:** Write clear, detailed requirements and acceptance criteria, including data model changes, schema definitions, API contracts, validation rules, and data lineage expectations.
* **Private Funds Data Modeling:** Define and evolve the domain data model, including GP/LP structures, master/feeder relationships, fund and asset taxonomies and sub-types, and the treatment of capital account and PCAP statements, capital call and distribution notices, and NAV and performance data.
* **Data Versioning & Integrity:** Specify how data is versioned, corrected, and restated (e.g., immutable, transaction-based designs), and define approaches to entity matching, alias/deduplication, and reconciliation across sources.
* **AI & Automation:** Shape and prioritize agentic and Generative AI capabilities, such as automated document procurement, extraction, classification, and validation. Define accuracy targets, human-in-the-loop review workflows, and evaluation methods.
* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work daily with engineering on architecture trade-offs, feature design, and delivery, ensuring solutions meet client needs and scale with data volume and complexity.
* **Roadmap Creation:** Develop and communicate the product roadmap, setting strategic direction for analytics, research and deal management, managed data services, and accounting capabilities.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Keep stakeholders informed on product updates, roadmap progress, and releases.
* **Client Engagement:** Engage with Clients of Clearwater who maybe a GP, LP to understand their workflows and data needs, and translate them into actionable enhancements.
* **Operational Partnership:** Work with data operations and service teams to measure and reduce manual intervention, turning root causes into product and automation improvements.
* **Success Measurement:** Define KPIs (e.g., data accuracy, coverage, timeliness, straight-through processing rates, adoption, NPS) and use data-driven insights to guide future decisions.
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Act as the go-to expert on private funds and alternative investments, supporting sales, client conversations, and product strategy.
* **Employee Engagement:** Participate in large-scale initiatives that promote employee retention and engagement.
* **Process Improvement:** Teach and guide other teams toward effective processes and best practices.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
* Deep knowledge of Private Markets (Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Assets, Fund of Funds) and the financial services landscape.
* Strong understanding of private fund structures and documents, including LPAs, capital account statements, PCAPs, capital calls and distributions, and NAV and performance reporting.
* Working technical fluency: relational data modeling, SQL, REST APIs, data pipelines, and ETL concepts. You can read schemas and engage credibly in design discussions.
* Familiarity with Generative AI and agentic AI technologies, including document intelligence, extraction, and evaluation, and an understanding of their practical limits in financial data workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate across sales, product, operations, and technology.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and documentation abilities.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and strong computer skills.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in product management or related roles, including experience owning a technical or data-intensive product.
* 4+ years of professional experience in Investment Management, Operations, or Accounting, with direct exposure to private funds data or workflows.
* Demonstrated experience writing business and technical requirements for a financial technology product or service.
* Experience in data visualization and analytics.
* Demonstrated client engagement experience, with a focus on understanding and addressing client needs.
* Experience presenting to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Alternative Investments, including Private Equity, Limited Partnerships, Private Credit, Mortgage and Bank Loans, or Derivatives.

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with fund administration, LP reporting, or portfolio monitoring platforms.
* Experience with master data management, entity resolution, or data quality frameworks.
* Hands-on experience launching AI-enabled data extraction or document processing products.

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Job Title: **Paid Search Manager**

Department: Paid Search

Reports to: Senior Paid Search Manager

Location: London, UK

**About Wildnet Technologies:**

Wildnet Technologies is an award-winning White Label Digital Marketing and IT Services with a track record of helping businesses and Google Partner Agencies achieve their goals. We offer a comprehensive range of high-quality Digital Marketing Services and On-Demand Technology Resources. With over 12,000 successful projects delivered to date, our team of 300+ professionals is headquartered in India and serves clients in the United States, Canada, Australia, and the United Kingdom. Our expertise includes SEO, Paid Search, Paid Social Services, programmatic advertising, and more.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As Paid Search Manager, you’ll play a vital role in shaping and delivering SINE Digital’s Paid Search strategy. Reporting to a Senior Paid Search Manager, you’ll oversee a small team, acting as a channel specialist responsible for driving innovation, ensuring best practice, and achieving

outstanding results for our clients.

This position requires solid hands-on experience in client communication, campaign strategy and performance management across key search platforms, including Google (Search, PMax/Shopping, Demand Gen), Microsoft Ads, Amazon Search, and Apple Search. Collaboration

with our SEO and Paid Social teams will be key to delivering integrated, data-driven strategies.

**Line Management**

+ Manage and mentor junior team members, ensuring workloads are balanced and development goals are met.

+ Conduct regular 1:1s and annual reviews, providing feedback and clear objectives to support professional growth.

+ Support recruitment, onboarding, and training processes, contributing to a positive and inclusive team culture.

+ Lead by example in fostering collaboration, curiosity, and performance excellence across the team. Operational Excellence

title: Product Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape and scale our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will own one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content, or growth — and will drive the roadmap from discovery to launch across web, Android, and iOS. You will work closely with founders, engineering, design, content, and marketing teams to deliver products that measurably improve student outcomes and business metrics.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for your product area and align it with business, content, and engineering priorities.
* Talk to students, parents, teachers, and internal teams to deeply understand pain points and learning behavior.
* Translate insights into clear PRDs, user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with design on wireframes, prototypes, and user testing; partner with engineering on scope, trade-offs, and delivery.
* Define, instrument, and track success metrics — engagement, retention, conversion, learning outcomes, and revenue.
* Run A/B experiments on pricing, paywalls, onboarding, notifications, and content discovery — and make data-backed calls on what ships.
* Collaborate on our conversion funnel — from YouTube/Shorts traffic to free users to paid course subscribers.
* Own feature launches end-to-end — launch plans, GTM alignment, customer comms, and post-launch monitoring.
* Prioritize ruthlessly using frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort) and communicate priorities clearly to stakeholders.
* Use product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA, or similar) and work with data/BI to build dashboards for your area.
* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, etc.) and translate learnings into opportunities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a consumer-facing product (preferably EdTech, mobile, or content platforms).
* Proven track record of shipping features that moved measurable business or user metrics.
* Strong user research skills — interviewing students/users, synthesizing insights, and turning them into product decisions.
* Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA) and basic SQL for self-serve data pulls.
* Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and interpreting results with statistical rigor.
* Experience writing clear PRDs, success criteria, and release plans that engineering and design teams can execute on.
* Strong understanding of conversion funnels, retention, and monetization patterns — especially freemium / tiered pricing.
* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade-offs — APIs, microservices, mobile constraints, performance.
* Experience shipping on mobile-first products (Android and iOS) and understanding platform-specific nuances.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp one-pager, present to founders, and debate trade-offs clearly.
* Bias for action, high ownership, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — particularly JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, or test-prep products.
* Experience building or scaling content-driven products (YouTube/Shorts funnels, creator-led GTM, live classes).
* Experience with assessments and test platforms — question banks, live tests, analytics on student performance.
* Familiarity with growth loops, referrals, student ambassador programs, and community-led growth.
* Exposure to live streaming products, push notification strategy, or personalization/recommendations.
* Prior startup experience — 0®1 product building and operating in early/growth-stage environments.
* MBA or equivalent structured business education (not required if experience is strong).

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you genuinely care about learning outcomes, not just feature velocity.
* First-principles thinker who can simplify complex problems and drive clarity for the team.
* Comfortable going from strategy to pixel-level detail in the same week.
* Data-driven, but not data-blind — you balance metrics with intuition and user empathy.
* Collaborative leader who earns trust across engineering, design, content, and marketing.
* High-agency — you spot problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: AI Enterprise Product Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an **AI Enterprise Product Manager** to drive the next phase of evolution of our existing enterprise AI platform. The core platform and several major capabilities are already developed. The mandate for this role is to **enhance the product, improve user adoption, strengthen the subscription experience, identify product gaps and continuously evolve the platform based on customer usage and market requirements**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously evolve the **product roadmap** for an existing AI enterprise platform.
* Deeply understand the current platform, its capabilities, user journeys and architecture, and identify opportunities for **enhancement, simplification and better adoption**.
* Translate customer feedback, usage patterns, sales inputs and market developments into clearly prioritized product improvements.
* Improve the overall **user journey from signup and onboarding to activation, regular usage, subscription and expansion**.
* Enhance the platform's **subscription model**, including plans, feature entitlements, trials, upgrades, usage controls and monetization opportunities.
* Identify friction in the product and improve **self\-service adoption and time\-to\-value**.
* Work closely with engineering and AI teams to enhance existing capabilities and introduce new features without unnecessarily increasing product complexity.
* Evaluate whether customer requirements should become **reusable platform capabilities** rather than customer\-specific implementations.
* Define detailed **PRDs, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria and release priorities**.
* Own prioritization across **product enhancements, customer requirements, technical improvements and strategic platform capabilities**.
* Define and track key product metrics including **activation, feature adoption, trial conversion, paid conversion, retention, usage and expansion**.
* Use product analytics and customer behavior to identify underused capabilities, adoption bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular customer and user discovery to validate product decisions and identify emerging requirements.
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to ensure alignment between **product capabilities, packaging, positioning and customer expectations**.
* Continuously track developments across **Enterprise AI, AI agents, agentic platforms and enterprise SaaS** and translate relevant developments into product decisions.

**Required Skills** 

* Strong experience in **B2B SaaS or enterprise product management**.
* Strong understanding of **subscription\-based SaaS products**, including onboarding, trials, plans, entitlements, upgrades and usage\-based/product\-tier monetization.
* Good understanding of **enterprise software, workflows and business processes**.
* Practical understanding of **Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents and agentic workflows**.
* Strong ability to evaluate an existing product and identify **UX, capability, adoption and monetization gaps**.
* Ability to distinguish between a **customer\-specific requirement and a scalable platform capability**.
* Strong experience with **product discovery, roadmap prioritization, PRDs, user stories and release management**.
